params.1274: Get a pickaxe (you can get a free one from Bob's Axes).
params.1275: Go to a rock containing copper or tin. You can find some in the south-east of Lumbridge Swamp.
params.1276: Click to start mining. You will collect ore from the rock and gain experience in that skill.
params.1277: Copper and tin yield 17.5 experience per ore.
params.1278: After gaining 83 XP, you will reach the next level in Mining and your mining speed will improve.
params.1279: Higher Mining levels will also allow you to mine better ores.
